set.Finding description: Magic Red Cathepsin B quantification across three independent experiments showed reduced lysosomal cathepsin-dependent proteolysis in APOE4 versus APOE3 Neuro-2a cells (APOE3 normalized to 1.0, APOE4 ~0.75).

why: Fig 1G is the quantification (APOE4 bar ~0.76 of APOE3), but its single '*' cannot be used: the Fig 1 key is garbled ('*p < .05, ****p < .01, *p < .0001' assigns '*' two thresholds) and the brief's ruling allows only '****' for this paper, so P stays N/A (note for the lane: p < .05 would hold under either reading of '*', if the ruling is ever relaxed).
Fig 6B shows '****' over the LGALS3BP pair (APOE3 ~95, APOE4 ~60 on a 0-600 axis), but the Fig 6 legend literally prints '****p < .0005', so the safe bound is <0.0005, not the reconstructed <0.0001.
Fig 1I has '****' over the FCCP APOE3-vs-APOE4 pair, but the Fig 1 key literally prints '****p < .01'; per the ruling for this paper only that literal bound is usable, not p < 0.0001.
Fig 1A DMSO bars read APOE3 1.0 vs APOE4 ~0.43 with '****' on that bracket, but the Fig 1 key literally prints '****p < .01', so P is <0.01, not <0.0001.
Fig 1H bars read APOE3 ~0.88 vs APOE4 ~0.79 with '****', but the Fig 1 key literally prints '****p < .01', so P is <0.01, not <0.0001.
The supplement legend has S1E as the representative LC3 blot and S1F as the LC3-II:LC3-I quantification across three replicates, and the quote cites Fig. S1D-F, so S1E-F is the right location.
The supplement legend defines S1C as 'Lysosomal density per cell based on images such as those in panel B', so the density result is in S1C.

Fig 4M reads E3 ~0.62 to ~0.95 (~1.5-fold) and E4 ~0.45 to ~1.01 (~2.2-fold) with no E3-vs-E4 bracket, so ~1.2x matches no comparison and the response ratio ~1.5x, with both folds named, fits the row's 'greater surface LRP8 response'; the legend confirms excess reelin and three experiments.
Fig 4M prints 'p < 0.0001' on the E4 axotomy(-) vs (+) bracket and 'p = 0.8156' on Ctrl, numbers printed on the figure count as printed_in_text, and the ~2.2x fold matches the bars.

Fig 2K prints p = 0.0311 on the APOE3-APOE4 bracket, the legend gives N = 18 wells per genotype across two lines with an unpaired t-test, and the APOE4 mean reads ~0.8 of APOE3, so the quantified row is right.
Fig 5J prints p = 0.0359 on the darkGFP-vs-INPP5D bracket, and the INPP5D mean (~0.5) against darkGFP (~1.0) gives ~0.5x, matching the quoted result.
